resumen: Spiritmaster with the best gear in the usual group (GS 3067) and solid DPS (46.4k, 3rd in both raids). Between their two nights they **improved survival a lot**: first death went from 92 s to 135 s and deaths per attempt from 1.67 to 1.18.
fortalezas: Big improvement from one night to the next: from dying among the first (92 s versus the group’s 114 s) to the group average (135 s versus 132 s).
DPS above the group average on both nights, with peaks of 57–69k in their best attempts.
mejorar: The zones are their main cause of death: 2920718 with 1802850 (7) and 2920717 with 1802830 (7).
8 deaths with no recorded ability, probably damage over time.
recomendaciones: Keep doing what changed between nights: reaching the zone phase alive is what raises your total damage the most.
Learn where 2920717 (45–100 s) and 2920718 (wall phase) appear and stand outside before they hit.
